notice: Coastal final-stay catalog reviewed 17 October 2026. Coordinates represent named localities, not exact stations or all beaches. Access durations are illustrative; no dated transport availability or pass entitlement is verified.

attractions.name: Waterfront gateway to the Ionian coast
attractions.description: A practical arrival point from Italy, with a waterfront stay and onward road transfers to smaller coastal towns. Research beaches outside the port centre.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.superfast.com/en-gb/ports-destinations

attractions.name: Patras waterfront and upper town
attractions.description: Combine waterfront walks with the upper town. This is a ferry arrival city; beach stays outside the centre and access to Araxos airport need separate transfers.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.superfast.com/en-gb/ports-destinations

attractions.name: Parga harbour and Valtos beach
attractions.description: Colourful harbour streets, a hilltop castle and nearby Valtos beach make a relaxed coastal base. Arrive by Italy–Igoumenitsa ferry, then a separately arranged road transfer.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.visitgreece.gr/en/islands/Epiro/Parga

attractions.name: Sivota coves and harbour
attractions.description: A small Ionian harbour base for coves and quiet seaside time. This is mainland Sivota near Igoumenitsa, not Syvota on Lefkada; arrange onward road transport from the ferry port.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.visitgreece.gr/en/islands/Epirus

attractions.name: Preveza waterfront and old town
attractions.description: A walkable old-town and waterfront base near the Ionian coast. Italy ferry access is via Igoumenitsa followed by a road transfer; Aktion airport also requires ground access.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.visitgreece.gr/

attractions.name: Lefkada Town and Ionian beaches
attractions.description: Stay in the colourful island capital and research trips to west-coast beaches. Reach the island by road over its mainland bridge after the Italy–Igoumenitsa ferry; beach trips need further local transport.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.visitgreece.gr/en/islands/ionian/lefkada

attractions.name: Sami waterfront and Kefalonian scenery
attractions.description: A port-town base for island exploring, with Antisamos beach and Melissani cave as research ideas. Arrive via Patras and a separate ferry to Sami; the airport is elsewhere on the island.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.levanteferries.com/en/routes/

attractions.name: Zakynthos Town and island beaches
attractions.description: Use the harbour town as a base for food and beach excursions. From the Italy ferry at Patras, arrange a road transfer to Kyllini and a separate ferry. Beach access and any boat excursions need current checks.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.levanteferries.com/en/routes/kyllini-zakynthos/

attractions.name: Monopoli old harbour and town beaches
attractions.description: Whitewashed old-town lanes and a working harbour beside small town beaches. Research regional trains from Bari and onward local access to beaches outside the centre.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.italia.it/en/puglia

attractions.name: Polignano cliff walks and Lama Monachile
attractions.description: A compact clifftop old town with sea views and the pebble cove of Lama Monachile. Research regional trains from Bari; the central cove can be busy and beach access involves steps.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.italia.it/en/puglia

attractions.name: Tropea old town and beach
attractions.description: A clifftop Calabrian old town above beaches and Santa Maria dell’Isola. The illustrative rail corridor from Naples can require changes; station-to-stay access and beach stairs need checking.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.italia.it/it/calabria/costa-degli-dei

attractions.name: Sorrento lanes and Marina Grande
attractions.description: A coastal base for waterfront meals and exploring the peninsula. Research EAV trains from Naples separately, including pass acceptance; Sorrento is mainly a cliff-and-marina stay rather than a broad sandy-beach resort.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.eavsrl.it/

attractions.name: Cefalù beach and Norman cathedral
attractions.description: A beach beside a historic Sicilian town, with its cathedral and La Rocca as ideas to explore. The modeled route uses the Naples–Palermo ferry, then a separately checked regional train.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.trenitalia.com/en/connections/cefalu-line.html

attractions.name: Lipari harbour and Aeolian island stay
attractions.description: A harbour-town base for volcanic scenery and island exploration. Research the Siremar sailing from Naples, including intermediate island calls, operating days and cabin availability.
attractions.source: Manual research lead, visitor details and transport unverified; reference: https://www.carontetourist.it/it/isole-eolie

attractions.name: Brindisi waterfront and a ferry gateway to Greece
attractions.description: A compact Puglian waterfront base with rail access and Grimaldi ferries to Igoumenitsa; Corfu calls are seasonal. The international ferry terminal is Costa Morena, not the old-town waterfront. Research the separate station–port bus/road transfer and ticket check-in requirements.
attractions.source: Manual research lead; transport/visitor details unverified. Reference: https://www.trenitalia.com/it/regionale/collegamenti-regionale/brindisi-air-port-link.html

attractions.name: Ancona harbour and the Conero coast
attractions.description: An Adriatic rail-and-ferry gateway for Greece, with a historic harbour city and the Conero coast as an excursion idea. Beaches outside the centre need local transport; the railway station, check-in office and boarding berth are separate points.
attractions.source: Manual research lead; transport/visitor details unverified. Reference: https://www.grimaldi-lines.com/en/route/ancona-igoumenitsa/

attractions.name: Salerno old town and waterfront
attractions.description: A coastal rail base south of Naples, with an old town and promenade. Research the separate Grimaldi crossing to Palermo. Match the assigned commercial-port terminal to your booking rather than assuming departure from the closest waterfront pier.
attractions.source: Manual research lead; transport/visitor details unverified. Reference: https://www.grimaldi-lines.com/en/route/salerno-palermo/

attractions.name: Piombino and the crossing to Elba
attractions.description: A small Tuscan port with access toward Elba. Research trains to Piombino Marittima and any train+bus replacement or final local connection; do not assume every train reaches the quay. Portoferraio on Elba is a separate final-stay option.
attractions.source: Manual research lead; transport/visitor details unverified. Reference: https://www.trenitalia.com/it/regionale/collegamenti-regionale/elba-link.html

attractions.name: Portoferraio harbour and Elba beaches
attractions.description: A historic harbour base for Elba, reached on the short ferry corridor from Piombino after separately checked rail/port access. Research local transport to beaches and departure-day access back to a mainland airport.
attractions.source: Manual research lead; transport/visitor details unverified. Reference: https://www.mobylines.com/routes/ferries-elba/piombino-portoferraio-piombino/

attractions.name: Gaios harbour and olive-covered Paxos
attractions.description: A smaller Ionian island stay reached on a separately booked ferry from Corfu. Research the exact Corfu departure terminal and seasonal frequency. Antipaxos can be a separate day-boat research idea; its excursion boats are not modeled as guaranteed transport or an overnight endpoint.
attractions.source: Manual research lead; transport/visitor details unverified. Reference: https://kerkyralines.com/route/kerkyra-paxoi/

attractions.name: Vathy harbour and Ithacan coves
attractions.description: A sheltered harbour-town stay on Ithaca. The modeled route uses the Patras–Sami–Pisaetos service, with Sami an intermediate port call, then a separate road transfer from Pisaetos to Vathy. No ferry is assumed to land in Vathy itself.
attractions.source: Manual research lead; transport/visitor details unverified. Reference: https://www.levanteferries.com/en/routes/patra-sami-ithaki/

attractions.name: Spartochori village and Meganisi bays
attractions.description: A small Ionian island stay. Arrive from Italy via Igoumenitsa and road access to Lefkada, continue to Nydri for the West Ferry crossing to Spilia, then arrange access up to Spartochori. This has several separate transfers and is not a direct sailing from Italy.
attractions.source: Manual research lead; transport/visitor details unverified. Reference: https://westferry.gr/
